purpose.zh: 练撑住身体、把分开的双腿抬离地面的力量
purpose.en: Build the strength to hold yourself up with your legs wide off the floor.

text.zh: 双手撑起，伸直的双腿分开离地
text.en: Press up on your hands and hold your straight legs wide off the floor
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.
Breathe steadily and do not hold your breath.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时缩短时间，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, hold for less time, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: EN 名改 Title Case：Wide-Leg L-Sit
training=hold（计时）；动画是静止撑住只有呼吸，批表的 3 次是呼吸
